view.name: Open project list
view.description: File menu drawer with the Open panel listing the user's saved ERD projects with search box and timestamps.

regions.label: Office-style File backstage: blue left rail (back arrow, New, Open, Properties, Account, Logout) plus grey 'Open' panel with search and recent project list
Ribbon-style app header behind the scrim: FILE/HOME/EDIT/ACCOUNT tabs, username, ribbon toolbar (New Table, Save, Export, Share, page size, Feedback)
Dimmed start page behind scrim: title, Recent/Help/New Feature/News link lists

evidence.note: Full-height panel from left edge over a dark translucent scrim covering the app; clicking scrim closes it (verified live); opened from the FILE ribbon tab
Persistent ribbon frame with tab row, user identity and toolbar
Ribbon tabs FILE/HOME/EDIT/ACCOUNT in DOM (covered by drawer in capture); switch ribbon toolbar panel
Outlined search input with placeholder and attached blue search button

patterns.rationale: A list of saved projects with name, thumbnail avatar and date plus a search box, for opening a file; but there is no folder hierarchy, path, or file operations, so it may be just a simple list.

evidence.note: Recent project list: avatar icon, name, timestamp, divided rows
The overlay is edge-anchored panel, coded as drawer instead
A toast appears live after clicking Properties but none is in the capture

structure.layout: desktop web app with Office-style ribbon header; File backstage drawer (blue nav rail + grey Open panel with project list) overlaid on left with a dark scrim over the dimmed start page

aesthetics.typography: 'Chinese Quote' (Ant Design system stack fallback) for body, nav labels, links, ribbon labels; Segoe UI for headings ('Open' 24px/500, project titles 14px/500, start-page title 30px)
aesthetics.typeScale: Modest: 30px start-page title, 24px panel heading, 20px section labels, 14px body/list items, 11px ribbon tab and button labels; weights 300-500

notes: Mimics Microsoft Office 2013 backstage: Word-blue (#2b569a) left rail with white light-weight labels and circular back-arrow icon, grey #f1f1f1 second column titled 'Open', rest of app behind a ~25% black scrim. Ant Design input+search button (#1890ff, 4px radius) and Ant List with avatar items: every project uses the same cute blue robot/cat avatar, name in Segoe UI and timestamp in grey. Ribbon behind uses grouped big-icon buttons (Table / Export / Page / Feedback groups). Clicking Properties without an open project triggers an Ant message toast (not in capture).
